note: Tuned to the First Person Probe sample controller. Targets are intentions, not measurements: change a target, run jump-arc, and the report tells you how far off the game is.

locomotion.moveSpeed.note: Counter-Strike runs about 6.35 m/s. Arena shooters sit well above this on purpose.

locomotion.accelTime.note: Time from standstill to full speed. Longer ramps read as ice.

jump.apexHeight.note: Roughly waist to chest height on a human-scaled character.

input.moveLatency.note: Frames between input arriving and the character moving. Human vision already lags reality by about 13ms; everything the engine adds is felt.
